options.description: The character drawn for the part still to do. Defaults to a light block.

options.description: Shows the time remaining beside the percentage. Defaults to false.

options.description: A label shown before the bar.
options.name: text

options.description: How many units of work there are. Defaults to 100.

options.name: unit
